recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to light gray #E8E8E8. 2. Top rule: draw a thin (~1-2pt) dark-red #8B1A1A horizontal line spanning the full slide width at the very top edge (occupying roughly the top 0-2% of slide height). 3. Title box: draw a rectangle with its left edge at ~11% of slide width, top edge at ~11% of slide height, ~23% wide and ~10% tall; fill it pale yellow #FFFFE1 with a 1.5pt blue #2222CC border; place the text 'Pre processing' inside in bold black sans-serif ~26pt, left-aligned. 4. Main content box: draw a rectangle with its left edge at ~10% of slide width, top edge at ~23% of slide height, ~82% wide and ~72% tall; fill it white #FFFFFF with a 1.5pt blue #2222CC border. 5. Lead sentence (first paragraph inside the content box): type 'Preprocessing' in bold red #CC2222 ~20pt, immediately followed by ' is ' in regular black ~20pt, immediately followed by 'Problem dependent and data dependent' in regular black italic ~20pt with underline. 6. Intro line (next line below the lead sentence): type 'It may include:' in bold black ~18pt. 7. Bulleted list (below the intro line): left-aligned, one item per line, small round black dot markers, regular black ~18pt, exactly 10 items in this order: 'Gap filling', 'Thinning', 'Contour', 'Binarization', 'Noise Removal', 'Color to Gray', 'Opening touched points', 'Resizing', 'Normalization', '.......'. 8. Add no photographs, icons, charts, or slide numbers — the slide contains none. 9. Exclude recording artifacts from the slide build: the mouse-cursor arrow near the 7th bullet ('Opening touched points') and the black bottom bar (~96%-100% of slide height) with its small red #CC0000 square at the far bottom-left are video-player/recording artifacts; include them only if the goal is to reproduce the video frame pixel-for-pixel.
